_note: Translation of the Japanese draft. Traditional accounts remain attributed.

chapter.title: Sunomata: The One-Night Castle
chapter.intro: Oda Nobunaga needs a foothold in Mino. Legend tells how Kinoshita Tokichiro and the Kawanami crew floated timber downriver and raised a castle at Sunomata in a single night. Accounts differ on how it was built. The timber is on its way. Finish the castle before dawn.

長蛇.name: Long Serpent Formation
長蛇.intro: Troops march in a long single file. It suits narrow roads and valleys but leaves the flank exposed.

方円.name: Circle Formation
方円.intro: Troops form a defensive ring around their commander, ready for attacks from any direction.

鶴翼.name: Crane's Wing Formation
鶴翼.intro: Troops form a V like a crane's outstretched wings, enveloping attackers from both sides.

魚鱗.name: Fish Scale Formation
魚鱗.intro: Troops form layered triangles like fish scales, concentrating force to break the enemy line head-on.

雁行.name: Wild Geese Formation
雁行.intro: Troops march diagonally like geese in flight, ready to answer threats on the flank.

偃月.name: Crescent Moon Formation
偃月.intro: Troops form a crescent and charge behind their commander. It lifts morale while exposing the commander to danger.

総懸かり.name: Full Assault Formation
総懸かり.intro: The whole army charges together, breaking formation for one decisive assault.

鋒矢.name: Arrowhead Formation
鋒矢.intro: An arrowhead concentrates force in the vanguard to pierce a single point in the enemy line.

衡軛.name: Yoke Formation
衡軛.intro: Two staggered columns advance while supporting one another.

03_秀吉.name: Kinoshita Tokichiro (Toyotomi Hideyoshi)
03_秀吉.line: An agile retainer whom Nobunaga called Monkey, he would later rule Japan as Toyotomi Hideyoshi.

01_信长.name: Oda Nobunaga
01_信长.line: The young lord of Owari was called a fool for his outlandish dress. At Okehazama he made his name across Japan.

05_胜家.name: Shibata Katsuie
05_胜家.line: Feared as Demon Shibata, he was a fierce Oda commander who first served Nobunaga's younger brother Nobukatsu.

04_利家.name: Maeda Toshiie
04_利家.line: A flamboyant eccentric and master of the spear, he sought to win his way back into Nobunaga's service after his dismissal.

05_小六.name: Hachisuka Koroku (Masakatsu)
05_小六.line: He is said to have led the river-wise Kawanami crew in helping Tokichiro build the castle at Sunomata.

06_長康.name: Maeno Nagayasu
06_長康.line: He and Koroku are said to have led the Kawanami crew in transporting timber and building the castle.

07_信盛.name: Sakuma Nobumori
07_信盛.line: A senior Oda retainer, he is said to have attempted to build at Sunomata before Tokichiro.

08_ねね.name: Nene
08_ねね.line: Tokichiro's wife, later known as Kita no Mandokoro. She is said to have supported him since their youth.

09_まつ.name: Matsu
09_まつ.line: Maeda Toshiie's wife. She is said to have been close to Nene and to have sustained the Maeda house through turbulent times.

10_龍興.name: Saito Tatsuoki
10_龍興.line: Head of the Saito house, he ruled Mino from Inabayama Castle and resisted the Oda invasion.

11_半兵衛.name: Takenaka Hanbei (Shigeharu)
11_半兵衛.line: A strategist said to have seized Inabayama Castle with a small band. He later aided Hideyoshi.

12_一鉄.name: Inaba Ittetsu (Yoshimichi)
12_一鉄.line: One of the West Mino Trio, remembered for his unbending resolve.

13_守就.name: Ando Morinari
13_守就.line: One of the West Mino Trio, he was also Takenaka Hanbei's father-in-law.

14_卜全.name: Ujiie Bokuzen (Naomoto)
14_卜全.line: One of the West Mino Trio, he went over to the Oda with Inaba Ittetsu and Ando Morinari.

rules.falling: When you match tiles, the tiles above them drop.
rules.construction: The top row shows the next timber supply. Each column with room gets one tile. Timber waits above full columns. Clear the board and all timber to win. Retreat restores both, and the clock keeps running.
rules.dawn: Decisive battle: Before Dawn! Timber arrives every 10 seconds. Clear the board and all timber before sunrise.
